scenicChapters.title: Litchfield Hills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 10 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Litchfield Hills Road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 22 km. 400 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

litchfield-hills-road.story: A one-way ride of 58 km, Kent to Winchester Center - roughly 1 h 07 in the saddle. On the way it passes Cornwall Bridge, Sharon and Lakeville. The line favours views over speed.
